purpose: Teach: 高圧/無秩序/慈悲/漂流/召喚/同化/戒め/惨事

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、高圧政策下の市民生活を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on civic life under authoritarian policy, didn't you?
lines.style: Clear, precise diction. Warm professional attention. Steady eye contact level. A teacher confirming what she already knows, inviting him to expand.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、無秩序状態下の社会復興を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on social reconstruction in the context of state collapse.
lines.style: Quiet, careful. Slight hesitation before 'collapse'—he's measuring his words. Respectful but not deferential. Sits a little straighter.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、近代の慈悲を巡る宗教思想を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you addressed modern religious philosophy around the concept of mercy, correct?
lines.style: Gentle inquiry with intellectual weight. Thoughtful pause before 'mercy.' Not lecturing—genuinely curious where his thinking led him.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、難民船の漂流事案を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I examined the refugee ship drifting incident as my case study.
lines.style: Steady voice, but a micro-hesitation on 'drifting'—it's a heavy topic. Direct, no elaboration. Eyes briefly down, then back up.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 国会の証人召喚史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You covered the history of witness summons in the Diet, didn't you?
lines.style: Engaged but not leading. Sharp attention. She's impressed, though it doesn't perform as praise. Leans forward slightly with genuine interest.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、少数民族の同化政策を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I looked at assimilation policy toward ethnic minorities.
lines.style: Quiet but firm. No apology in the delivery. He knows the gravity of what he's studied. Brief, because the subject speaks for itself.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、戦時下の戒めの言説を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper examined wartime rhetoric of moral discipline, didn't it?
lines.style: Slower tempo. More weight on each phrase. She's moved—his work is serious, and she wants him to feel that recognition.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、近代の海上惨事の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I researched modern maritime disasters and their historical precedent.
lines.style: Careful, deliberate. Small breath between clauses. He closes on a quieter note—not trailing off, but settling. The work is complete, the answer is done.
